newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche says meeting in Moscow on Russian debt.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche says meeting in Moscow on Russian debt.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG said on Wednesday it was meeting with officials from Russia's Vneshekonombank in Moscow to discuss the rescheduling of Russia's debt to the London Club of commercial bank creditors.
"There is a working meeting with Deutsche Bank which is the closing agent for the rescheduling," a Deutsche spokesman said in response to a Reuter enquiry.
Banking sources said the meeting may agree on dates for the final conclusion of the rescheduling of Russia's commercial bank debt.
The sources said there may be a news release on the outcome of the meeting.
Dealers in London said Russia may propose reducing the threshold necessary to close the debt rescheduling agreement to 75 percent from 90 percent.
Under current terms, Russia needs to reconcile fully 90 percent of the $24 billion principal of its total $35 billion debt owed to the London Club.
